assessment.nobel_worthiness: A preventive intervention of exceptional global medical importance, linking a clear virological principle to prevention of cancer.
assessment.attribution: The three listed scientists represent complementary foundational work on virus-like-particle vaccines and their translation.
assessment.maturity: The biological principle and durable clinical and public-health impact are well established.
uncertainties: The contribution spans a broad translational and implementation history beyond any three individuals.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology enabled a major therapeutic transformation for diabetes and obesity with very large clinical consequences.
assessment.attribution: The proposed trio captures key physiological and mechanistic contributions, though medicinal development involved further essential contributors.
assessment.maturity: The therapeutic class has extensive clinical validation and its physiological basis is mature.
uncertainties: Credit allocation among discovery, physiological characterization, and drug development is difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Antisense correction of SMN2 splicing established a precise RNA-therapeutic strategy for a previously devastating inherited disease.
assessment.attribution: The two credited names provide a coherent bridge from splicing mechanism to therapeutic platform and application.
assessment.maturity: Clinical benefit and the causal molecular logic are firmly demonstrated.
uncertainties: The wider development pathway included additional important academic and industrial contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: CAR-T therapy created a powerful new therapeutic modality and demonstrated that engineered immune cells can produce durable cancer responses.
assessment.attribution: The listed scientists cover central clinical, conceptual, and engineering contributions to the field.
assessment.maturity: Clinical efficacy is established, including durable remissions in selected hematological cancers.
uncertainties: The field has a diffuse intellectual ancestry and important limitations in solid tumors remain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Fetal cell-free DNA transformed prenatal testing by making genetic screening far less invasive and broadly clinically usable.
assessment.attribution: The single credited scientist offers unusually clear attribution for the seminal diagnostic concept.
assessment.maturity: The approach is extensively validated and has become an important component of prenatal care.
uncertainties: Clinical implementation raises ethical and health-system questions that are distinct from the discovery itself.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The unfolded protein response revealed a fundamental system by which cells sense and respond to stress in the endoplasmic reticulum.
assessment.attribution: Mori and Walter are strongly associated with defining complementary components of this conserved signaling architecture.
assessment.maturity: Its mechanisms and broad relevance to normal physiology and disease have been extensively developed.
uncertainties: The pathway comprises several branches and a larger body of contributors than can be recognized.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Chaperonin-assisted folding fundamentally changed understanding of how proteins achieve functional conformations in cells.
assessment.attribution: The proposed pair has clear and complementary claims to the central experimental and conceptual advance.
assessment.maturity: The principle is deeply established across molecular and cellular biology.
uncertainties: Its direct medical framing is less immediate than for several translational candidates.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adult stem-cell-derived organoids created a versatile experimental system for studying tissue maintenance, disease, and personalized medicine.
assessment.attribution: Clevers and Sato are closely identified with the foundational adult-tissue organoid advance.
assessment.maturity: The technology is widely adopted and its value for experimental medicine is established.
uncertainties: Organoid systems remain imperfect representations of intact tissues and the full clinical impact is still developing.
